hypothesis: A finite retry after the reported reset closes the early-check gap without permanent short polling.
reason: Independent reviewer permits finite delivery canary, deferring routine calendar retries until observed delivery.

supportingEvidence.claim: Observed early exhausted check had no reset retry.

contraryEvidence.claim: Configuration was verified but future delivery and overlap exclusion were unproven.

unknowns: Host date/timezone semantics and future delivery; no enforced concurrency lock verified.

prediction.ifTrue: A finite canary arrives at the intended UTC minute; reset retry planning handles both windows.
prediction.ifFalse: Calendar schedule rejects or delivers outside intended slot; no production calendar retry claim.

test.action: One finite canary plus pure early-reset/both-window/stale/unknown/busy cases.
test.success: Observed intended canary delivery and passing boundary tests.
test.failure: Stop calendar rollout if canary fails; bounded same-heartbeat fallback only near reset.
